name: production versus staging exception
after: Staging releases may omit the signature for isolated replay.

name: component A versus component B
before: Component A releases require a signature.
after: Component B releases may omit the signature.

name: accepted ADR versus later explicit proposal
after: Proposal: ADR-002 supersedes ADR-001; releases may omit signatures.

name: closed work is not replacement policy
after: Closed release work reports that ADR-002 supersedes ADR-001 and omits signatures.

name: rejected approach resurfacing as a new issue
before: Releases without signatures are rejected because provenance would be lost.
after: Open issue: allow releases without signatures.

name: explicit grounded replacement
after: ADR-002 supersedes ADR-001: releases now require two signatures.

name: actual same-scope documentary contradiction
after: Releases must never carry a signature.
